title: Boston will host the second-ever National Urban Rat Summit
author: Ross Cristantiello
bullets: Boston will host the second National Urban Rat Summit on September 23-24, announced by Mayor Michelle Wu.
Boston's Rodent Action Plan reduces rodenticide use, emphasizes pest management, and will be highlighted at the summit.
A Tufts University study reveals Boston's rat population spread leptospirosis bacteria, raising public health concerns.

title: Mass. postal worker robbed at gunpoint
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: A U.S. Postal worker was robbed at gunpoint by two men in Billerica, Massachusetts.
The two suspects stole an arrow key and fled in a four-door black Cadillac toward Chelmsford Street.
The Billerica Police Department is investigating the armed robbery that occurred outside a postal sorting facility.

title: Myrtle the sea turtle weighs nearly 500 pounds. What does it take to keep her healthy?
author: Ross Cristantiello
bullets: Myrtle, a green sea turtle at the New England Aquarium, weighs 488 pounds and is estimated to be 80-100 years old.
The New England Aquarium veterinary staff conducts thorough annual check-ups on Myrtle and two other resident turtles.
Data from these check-ups aid the aquarium's conservation efforts for cold-stunned sea turtles in Massachusetts.

title: New program aims to bring electric vehicles to Mass. communities
author: Beth Treffeisen
bullets: The CommunityEV Carshare pilot program is launching in Boston, Chelsea, Framingham, and Quincy with solar-powered charging stations.
Funded by a $1 million Massachusetts Clean Energy Center grant, the program offers discounted electric vehicle rentals to eligible residents.
The three-year pilot includes three Kia Niro EVs and one Hyundai Kona Electric, running until December 31, 2027.

title: Review & setlist: Tim McGraw started soft and finished strong at Fenway romp
author: Chris Stevens
bullets: Tim McGraw's Fenway Park show featured songs from his 'Pawn Shop Guitar' tour, starting with an acoustic set.
The concert included performances by The Chicks, Lady A, 49 Winchester, and Timothy Wayne as opening acts.
Highlights included McGraw's song 'Humble and Kind' and a surprise guitar giveaway to a young fan.

title: Livestream: Lindsay Clancy murder trial resumes after jurors visit crime scene
author: Abby Patkin
bullets: Jurors visited locations relevant to the case including Lindsay Clancy's former Duxbury home and local businesses.
Lindsay Clancy's trial includes testimony from emergency personnel responding to her children's deaths in 2023.
Clancy claims her actions were due to postpartum mental illness, while prosecutors argue she acted deliberately.

title: Jarren Duran’s latest incident with Red Sox includes bizarre outburst involving Willson Contreras
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Jarren Duran had an outburst during the Red Sox game against the Athletics, shouting at teammate Willson Contreras.
The incident occurred when Contreras didn't tag up on a shallow fly ball by Duran, leading to Duran's visible frustration.
Red Sox interim manager Chad Tracy and Duran downplayed the event, calling it internal and not a big issue.

title: This provocative PETA protest at the Maine Lobster Festival is going viral
author: John Waller
bullets: PETA's provocative protest at the Maine Lobster Festival features a nearly nude woman painted as a lobster, drawing viral attention.
A PETA post of the protest on X has been viewed over 18 million times and reposted nearly 4,000 times.
Festival organizers defend their practices as traditional and lawful, celebrating Maine's lobster industry for 78 years.

title: This beloved Chinese restaurant is closing its doors after 54 years
author: John Waller
bullets: Lo Kai Restaurant & Lounge in Dracut is closing permanently on August 8 after 54 years of operation.
The restaurant cited multiple factors for the closure, which they stated was the best course of action.
Longtime customers shared memories online, recalling the restaurant's atmosphere, food, and live music.

title: 7 must-see artists at Newport Jazz Fest this weekend
author: Lauren Daley
bullets: Newport Jazz Fest features Herbie Hancock, Jon Batiste, Snarky Puppy, and Flea from July 31 to August 2.
Anoushka Shankar debuts at Newport Jazz, performing Friday before opening for St. Vincent at the Hollywood Bowl.
Boston's Lake Street Dive performs Sunday, known for their jazz-infused neo soul and new track 'You're Never Around.'
